## Activity

Capture activity at Harbour Eye Clinic during October 2018 totalled 386. This report records the volume of images captured during the month and provides a summary of image quality and grading outcomes. The activity figure should be considered alongside the number of images that were unsuitable for grading and the number of results requiring referral.

## Image quality

A total of 26 photographs could not be graded. This represents an ungradable rate of 6.7. The clinic should continue to monitor image quality during routine operations and ensure that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. Recording these issues consistently will support follow-up and help identify any ongoing operational concerns affecting image capture.

## Grading

Grading identified 53 referable results. The median wait from photograph to grade was 2 days. This provides an overview of the time taken for images to progress through grading during October 2018. The activity, image quality and grading figures should be reviewed together as part of routine site monitoring for Harbour Eye Clinic.
